_for: W4 published_results.json — the PDMS_v1_navtest rows, re-read from the BANKED primary
_protocol_definition: PDMS = NC*DAC*(5*EP + 5*TTC + 2*C)/12; DDC exists with weight 0. Reported x100. Devkit v1.1 (navsim v1.1 branch); main/0a380a9 is v2 and computes EPDMS — NEVER mix the two in one table.

_split.name: navtest
_split.construction: OpenScene test frames filtered so that the constant-velocity agent scores <= 0.8 PDMS and the human >= 0.8 (paper Sec. 3.1, p. 5)

_source_primary.title: NAVSIM: Data-Driven Non-Reactive Autonomous Vehicle Simulation and Benchmarking

_source_secondary.evidence_class: INHERITED (not re-retrieved by W3; a moving target)

rows.note: the devkit's own baseline; it is also the agent navtest was FILTERED with, so it cannot be read as a generic floor — see W3's STOP floor
BLIND baseline (velocity, acceleration, driving command). Checkpoints published at autonomousvision/navsim_baselines (3 seeds)
camera-only sensor agent (3 cropped forward cameras concatenated to 1024x256)
BEVFormer backbone over 8 surround cameras x 4 temporal frames (paper Sec. 4.2 prose; the Table 1 tick columns are Ego Stat./Image/LiDAR/Video)
the logged human trajectory itself — a CEILING, never a deployable row. EP < 100 because progress is normalised against a privileged rule-based planner
